newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher; uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher; uptrend seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Tuesday after the central bank issued T$5 billion negotiable certificates of deposit to mop up excess funds in the market, dealers said.

The overnight interbank closed at 6.396 percent against Monday's 5.977 close -- well above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper at 5.85-6.25 percent against 5.75-6.00.
Dealers said they expected the rates to continue rising due to Wednesday's scheduled payment of T$15 billion in treasury bills.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8475 percent against 5.8400.
